meta.title: Desk check-in
meta.description: Checks you in at your desk on weekdays, compares the arrival time with a fixed baseline and your recent average, and tracks how many workdays in a row you have shown up. It nudges you to write down what you studied and how you felt (kept separately). It also keeps a wishlist of things you want to learn: drop an idea in without scheduling it, tick it off when you are done, and that tick writes a study-log entry for the day. On Friday it produces two reports: a statistics sheet and a prose version ready to post. Every record is kept on disk and folded into the conversation context. Available from the desktop pet's context menu, the /gongwei command, and the "Wishlist" and "Journal" panels in DSH settings; the pet bubble shows a model-compressed summary while the full text lives in the "Journal" panel.
